input_text: Explain Newton's first law of motion.
expected_answer_scope_en: An object at rest stays at rest and an object in motion stays in motion at constant velocity unless acted upon by an external unbalanced force; this is the law of inertia.

input_text: What is the difference between an atom and a molecule?
expected_answer_scope_en: An atom is the smallest unit of an element retaining its chemical identity; a molecule is two or more atoms chemically bonded together, of the same or different elements.
